comment: FOC-990: the Fenix runtime's path/state env that a suite file must never inherit. ONE list, two consumers: scripts/test-run.mjs strips it from every suite process (so a child running `node scripts/test-run.mjs` inside the container is as hermetic as CI) and docker/test-in-container.sh unsets it before the suite. The image points these at the /data volume; a test that honours one writes into the live install. LA_SUPERVISOR* is stripped by prefix in test-run.mjs and is not listed here except LA_SUPERVISOR_STATE_HOME, which the shell needs by name.
